scope: Frozen final workflow for one prespecified shared-capital portfolio; existing independent-rule studies remain distinct. Extends the existing RES-001/002/003/004, ACCT-002 and UI-004 cases without removing any of the422 acceptance cases.

policy.portfolio_unit: One fixed set of one to64 unique complete Strategy configurations, canonicalized by configuration hash before registration. Screen discovery and validation as two complete shared-capital accounts. The whole unchanged set is either the sole candidate or no candidate; never screen members separately then recombine survivors.
policy.gates: Apply the existing minimum-trades, positive-net-profit and defined minimum marked-Sharpe gates to each complete joint account. Gates do not certify a trading edge. Exact trade/Sharpe boundaries pass, profit must be strictly positive, both windows are required, and malformed/nonfinite metrics reject. The pure truth-table fixtures are gate tests, not trading accounts.
policy.freeze: Registration event binds complete initial study inputs including mode, rule membership, windows, dataset/core, costs, account, seed and exact calendar. Candidate event binds the later candidate hash/count. Detect hash-consistent input amendment before job creation, before reuse and before final consumption.
policy.final: Consume final dates once before any final raw-price read. Only the exact frozen set and frozen account inputs may run. A canceled/failed job can continue under its original job ID without consuming again; new final job or amended set is forbidden.
policy.ledger: Portfolio screening has exactly two portfolio-role account occurrences at part0/discovery and part0/validation. Final has one portfolio-role occurrence at part0/report. Configuration identity is the whole ordered rule set, not a count of independent member strategies.
policy.saved_outputs: Each account saves study ID, mode, phase, original input hash and final candidate hash where applicable; full configurations, per-rule charts, attribution, trades, marks, ledger, costs, calendar, borrowing, dataset and core. Root screening/final rows identify a portfolio without pretending it is a single family. JSON/CSV/presenter and saved inspection never reread protected prices.
policy.recovery: Complete part/content hashes and trial attempts/reuses remain durable. Reject altered committed parts/results/inputs/calendar/manifest before reuse or prices; reconstruct only uncommitted work. Cover interruption before consumption, after consumption, between accounts, after part publication and after root publication. No partial successful comparison or false final completion.
policy.ui: Choose independent rules or shared portfolio before registration, select immutable saved members, display exact frozen membership, show screening/final account labels, candidate unit/count, consumed status and audit events, inspect mixed-rule charts/trades and export complete results. Cover both desktop sizes, stale selection/navigation, empty/losing/no-candidate and actual cancel/resume flows.
policy.reservation: Portfolio queueing atomically reserves reserved_final_job_id and a portfolio_final_reserved event. This lifecycle field is excluded from initial input hashing, while the immutable reservation event binds it to the original candidate hash. A queued cancellation still resumes that same job; reservation is not final-date consumption. Independent-study semantics remain otherwise unchanged.

BOS1m,long,strength2,level stop,zero buffer,no timeout; targets4R and5R. Zero explicit fees/spread/slippage/borrowing; documented stop tick remains. Capital10000,risk0.1,symbol/total exposure1,participation1. Both rules compete for the same cash. Discovery05-06,validation07-08,final09-12.
